facts: Parties: Thornbury Capital LLP (Buyer), Yarrow Capital LLP (Seller); the Company is Redcliffe Media Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 1 March 2026; Closing is scheduled for 31 May 2026 (the 'Closing Date').
Section 12.1: the Seller shall not compete with the business for 4 years after Closing.
Section 3.4 (Earn-out): the Earn-out Payment equals 2 times the amount by which FY2026 EBITDA exceeds $6,500,000, capped at $3,000,000.
Section 4.5: if the Conditions are not satisfied by the date falling 150 days after the date of this Agreement (signed 1 March 2026), either party may terminate.
Clause 18: the Founder shall not compete with the business for 18 months after termination of employment.
Management accounts show FY2026 EBITDA of $8,600,000; the Seller says the Earn-out Payment will therefore be $3,600,000.
Regulatory counsel expects merger clearance by 12 September 2026.
